scenes.query: Why Do Dolphins Sleep with Only Half Their Brain?

description: Dolphins have a unique way of sleeping that helps them stay alert for predators. They sleep with only half their brain at a time, a process called unihemispheric slow-wave sleep. This allows them to rest while still being aware of their surroundings. Follow us for more fascinating animal facts!
